text: ok the other thing and bit unrelated but why does every build chew away at disk space. and where the hell do u clean it out in, because its like 500mb or something every build from how fast it chews through it so it seems

events.text: Root cause: zig NEVER evicts .zig-cache/o entries and every build embeds a fresh bundle.js -> new content hash -> new multi-hundred-MB cache entry. Cache had grown to 756GB (3,947 entries, disk 100% full at 2.3GB free). Pruned everything older than June 30: freed 679GB (disk now 81%, cache 79GB). Permanent guard shipped in 9a4b29cbb: ship+dev auto-prune entries older than 7 days after every successful build (RJIT_CACHE_PRUNE_DAYS overrides, 0 disables), plus a manual 'rjit clean [--days N | --all]' command with size report; prune runs under the ship flock so it can't race an in-flight build. rjit.js rebundled+committed. zig-out/bin (15GB of old shipped cart binaries) left untouched.
